dedupe_keys.name: ncss soil characterization database lab data mart

description: The NCSS Soil Characterization Database holds laboratory measurements on soil profiles (pedons): physical, chemical, biological, mineralogical and morphological data, with mid-infrared spectroscopy for selected samples. It is produced by the USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service through its soil survey laboratory for the National Cooperative Soil Survey. Coverage is more than 65,000 locations in the United States and its territories and about 2,100 sites abroad, as point data. The data are served free through the Lab Data Mart as comma-delimited files and database downloads and through the Soil Data Access web services, under a public domain mark; the Data.gov entry was updated on 10 June 2026. Caveats: sampling locations reflect where surveys needed laboratory support, so coverage is uneven, and methods have changed over the decades, which affects comparisons. For simulation it gives measured soil properties to calibrate crop, hydrological and geotechnical models and to check the soil maps used in flood, drought and ground hazard exposure studies. It is related to the Web Soil Survey record in this catalogue, which maps soils across counties, and the OpenLandMap SoilDB record, which includes these profiles in a global compilation.
